description: Finite positive paths describe the transitive closure, and arbitrary finite paths the reflexive transitive closure.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.Relations.paths_characterize_closures.{u} {α : Type u} (R : α → α → Prop) (a b : α) :
  (Relation.TransGen R a b ↔ ∃ n, 0 < n ∧ Lemmatheca.SetTheory.Relations.relationPower R n a b) ∧
    (Relation.ReflTransGen R a b ↔ ∃ n, Lemmatheca.SetTheory.Relations.relationPower R n a b)
